name: Large Circular Basin with Stylized Lotus Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；8th century；Sancai ("three-color") ware: white earthenware with lead-fluxed clear, emerald-green, and caramel-brown glazes over stamped decoration on the interior and lead-fluxed caramel-brown glaze on the exterior. Probably from kilns at Luoyang or Gongxian, Henan province.
